answer: New agents enter through a falcon checkpoint: each identity posts a 60-unit bond and may trade only across one canyon corridor, capped at 5 trades per epoch. A wandering audit team of three random established agents re-checks one corridor per epoch; if a fake identity is found, its 60-unit bond is burned and the corridor closes for 10 epochs. An attacker running 100 fakes must post 6,000 units and loses every bond the moment one audit catches a shared corridor, so mass fakes pay real capital for almost no trade volume.
